name: Spirit Blink
text: Spirit Blink Aspect Soul Activate Two Actions command, envision; Frequency once per day; Effect You blink between the realm of mortals and the Ethereal Plane.

name: Soul Magic
text: Soul Magic Aspect Soul Activate Single Action envision; Frequency once per day; Effect You infuse yourself or a willing creature that you touch with spiritual energy.

name: Charming
text: Charming Aspect Artistry Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect You speak briefly about your craft or enact a short performance.

name: Enthralling
text: Enthralling Aspect Artistry Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect You speak at length about or demonstrate your craft, or you enact a performance.

name: Dominant Emotion
text: Dominant Emotion Aspect Emotion Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You would be adversely affected by an emotion effect; Effect The relic tries to neutralize the triggering effect with its own emotion, attempting a counteract check.

name: Emotion Surge
text: Emotion Surge Aspect Emotion Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect A surge of emotion emanates from your relic, granting a +1 status bonus to skill checks determined by the relic's emotion.

name: Fervor
text: Fervor Aspect Emotion Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect You gain the emotional fervor benefits for your relic's emotional state for the next 3 rounds, but ignore the spell associated with the fervor.

name: Beginner's Luck
text: Beginner's Luck Aspect Luck Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger You attempt a d20 roll you're untrained in; Effect You treat your proficiency bonus as equal to half your level, or if the relic is 7th level or higher, as equal to your level.

name: Swap Luck
text: Swap Luck Aspect Luck Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You roll a failure or critical failure on a saving throw against an effect with multiple targets; Effect You swap rolls with another target who's willing to swap with you.

name: Whammy
text: Whammy Aspect Luck Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger An enemy within 30 feet rolls a success on an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check; Effect Your relic sends out a wave of bad luck, forcing the creature to reroll and take the worse result.

name: Steal Luck
text: Steal Luck Aspect Luck Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per day; ; Trigger You or a creature within 30 feet of you rolls two d20s for a fortune or misfortune effect and you like the higher roll; Effect You steal the higher of the two numbers the triggering target rolled; the target must use the other result.

name: Sands of the Hourglass
text: Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per hour; Effect You target one creature within 30 feet, temporarily imposing the decrepitude of time on it.

name: Precognition
text: Precognition Aspect Time Activate Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger Your turn starts; Effect You analyze diverging time streams to determine the best course of action.

name: Temporal Pulse
text: Temporal Pulse Aspect Time Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect You make time shudder around you, stealing it from enemies and granting it to allies.

name: Time Jump
text: Time Jump Aspect Time Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic casts time jump on you to your specifications.

name: Time Reversal
text: Time Reversal Aspect Time Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect The relic casts time beacon on you.

name: Creative Spark
text: Creative Spark Aspect Forge Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You strike the relic against a piece of flint and summon a fire wisp to assist you, which appears in an unoccupied square next to you. Once per day, when you roll a critical failure on a Crafting check related to blacksmithing, you get a failure instead.

name: Forge Weld
text: Forge Weld Aspect Forge Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You strike the relic against a non-magical metal object of 4 Bulk or less, repairing it.

name: Work Harden
text: Work Harden Aspect Forge Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You strike the relic against a shield or armor made of metal, and steam pours from it like it's just been quenched.

name: Molten Crucible
text: Molten Crucible Aspect Forge Activate Three Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You strike your relic against a weapon, armor, or shield made of metal.

name: Living Forge
text: Living Forge Aspect Forge Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect The relic is absorbed into your body, and you transform into an elemental being of red-hot steel.

name: Precious Anodization
text: Precious Anodization Aspect Metal Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect For one minute, your relic is affected by a clad in metal spell of a rank equal to half the relic's level, rounded up.

name: Rail Dash
text: Rail Dash Aspect Metal Activate Two Actions ; Frequency once per hour; Effect Your relic conjures a guideway of magnets beneath you, creating a frictionless path for you to rush forward at high speeds.

name: All Will Decay
text: Activate Two Actions (aura, concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Rusted flakes swirl in a cloud around you, creating a 15-foot emanation that lasts for 1 minute.

name: Ancestors' Call
text: Activate Single Action envision; Frequency once per hour; Effect Select one of the three ancestry feats.

name: Propelling Winds
text: Propelling Winds Aspect Air Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per hour; Effect The relic casts fly targeting you.

name: Call of the Wild
text: Call of the Wild Aspect Beast Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic summons a creature to fight at your side, casting summon animal with a spell rank of half the item's level rounded up.

name: Word of Faith
text: Word of Faith Aspect Celestial Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per hour; Effect Placing your hand on yourself or an ally, you heal their wounds and bolster their spirit.

name: Righteous Call
text: Righteous Call Aspect Celestial Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect Holy magic fills your armaments, making them true weapons against evil.

name: Angelic Vessel
text: Angelic Vessel Aspect Celestial Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect At your invitation, a celestial imbues your body with the divine.

name: Shroud of the Afterlife
text: Shroud of the Afterlife Aspect Death Activate Single Action (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You shroud yourself with powers from beyond the living realm for 1 minute.

name: Grim Specter
text: Grim Specter Aspect Death Activate Two Actions (concentrate, polymorph, void) Frequency once per day; Effect You can call upon the terrifying powers that fuel your relic to transform yourself into a specter of death.

name: Rolling Geode
text: Rolling Geode Aspect Earth Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect Stone and crystal form a sphere that chases your foes. If the geode enters a creature's space, the creature must succeed at a basic Reflex save or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage; a creature can take damage this way only once per turn, even if you roll the geode through its space multiple times.

name: Shattered Earth
text: Shattered Earth Aspect Earth Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per hour; Effect Seismic pulses from your relic ripple through the nearby ground, shaking sharp fragments to the surface. A creature that enters an affected square during a move action must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save or take 1d6 piercing damage; it needs to roll only once per move action even if it moves thro

name: Raise Ramparts
text: Raise Ramparts Aspect Earth Activate Three Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic reshapes the earth around you.

name: Living Statue
text: You can cast 6th-rank petrify and sure footing (to remove petrification only) as innate spells, each once per day.

name: Fiendish Bargain
text: Fiendish Bargain Aspect Fiend Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect You bargain with the evil force empowering your relic for a boon, though you must trade something in return.

name: Heat Haze
text: Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic erratically elevates the air temperature around you, creating heat shimmers that distort your appearance and grant you the concealed condition for 1 minute.

name: Incandescent Sight
text: Incandescent Sight Aspect Fire Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your eyes become attuned to heat signatures as your vision extends into the infrared, granting you a heatsight precise sense for 1 minute.

name: Jet Propulsion
text: Jet Propulsion Aspect Fire Activate Single Action (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect Flames from your relic channel through your body, erupting from your feet, hands, or other limbs with enough force to blast you across the ground and propel you through the air.

name: Bestow Life
text: Bestow Life Aspect Life Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect An infusion of vitality energy from your relic can temporarily animate an unliving object.

name: Healing Wave
text: Healing Wave Aspect Life Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect You release a wave of vitality energy in a 15-foot cone.

name: Life Everlasting
text: Life Everlasting Aspect Life Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Massive amounts of vitality energy surge forth.

name: Perception Filter
text: Perception Filter Aspect Mind Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic reaches into the minds of nearby creatures and blocks your presence from their perceptions.

name: Sprout Ally
text: Sprout Ally Aspect Plant Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic rapidly matures and animates nearby plant matter into an ally to fight by you, casting summon plant or fungus , with a rank of half the item's level rounded up.

name: Petal Dance
text: Petal Dance Aspect Plant Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Effect You discorporate into a cloud of petals and leaves.

name: Megaflora
text: Megaflora Aspect Plant Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect With a pulse of natural energy, your relic grows massive plants in an instant. This is a healing and wood effect, and a given creature can heal from the tree only once per round.

name: Dancing Shadow
text: Activate Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per hour; Effect Your relic's shadow detaches from your relic and dances through the air to attack an enemy.

name: Monsoon Curtain
text: Monsoon Curtain Aspect Water Activate Three Actions (attack, concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect You call down a curtain of violent rain in a location within 120 feet.

name: Tidal Crash
text: Tidal Crash Aspect Water Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Your relic spews forth a dense sphere of water.

name: Ripples and Waves
text: Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Ankle-deep water floods outward from you, filling a 60-foot emanation centered on you for 1 minute.

name: Azata's Grace
text: Azata's Grace Aspect Celestial Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect Monarch opens a conduit to Desna's palace of Cynosure and infuses your soul with the grace of the azatas who dance and frolic therein.

name: Seer's Array
text: Four Items : You can use the relic's time jump once per hour. Five Items : You can use the relic's precognition once per hour.
